cards.stem: What action defines binary search on a sorted array?
options: dividing the search interval in half
building a hash table for keys
cards.quote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.
cards.hint: Think about how the interval changes each step.

cards.stem: What is the run time of binary search?
When does the usual midpoint formula overflow?
options: close to the largest expressible integer
cards.quote: This overflows if high and low are close to the largest expressible integer.
cards.hint: Think about limits of integer representation.

cards.stem: How many comparisons does binary search use on an ordered linked list?
cards.quote: It makes O(n) traversals, as does linear search, but it only performs O(log n) comparisons.
